name: Ring USD
oneLiner: USDR is Ring Protocol's centrally managed synthetic dollar minted against protocol-controlled crypto collateral, with no public redemption route documented.
collateral: Ring protocol crypto collateral and strategy assets managed through the protocol reserve system
pegMechanism: USDR is collateralized by a Protocol Controlled Value (PCV) reserve funded through bonding-curve issuance; PCV is allocated to liquidity and the token can be over- or under-collateralized depending on reserve conditions; no holder-exercisable redemption route is source-reviewed for Pharos backstop scoring

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

reserves.name: Ring protocol crypto collateral and liquidity positions

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: Ring Protocol materials describe protocol liquidity controls, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a holder-exercisable redemption route for backstop scoring.

mintAuthority.summary: Ring USD (USDR) is a Fei-fork ERC20Burnable whose MINTER_ROLE holders can mint to any address uncapped; roles are managed by Ring Protocol's Core access-control contract (0xb2799…). At block 25295203: MINTER_ROLE has 4 holders (3 EOAs + RingLaunchpad contract); GOVERN_ROLE has 3 holders (Core itself + 2 EOAs); no revocations recorded.

controls.label: USDR Minter role (Core-gated) — 3 EOA minters
controls.capDescription: Uncapped mint to any address for any MINTER_ROLE holder. Current EOA minters: 0x9336d0c…, 0x4f0aa59…, 0xf079c35…
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0/1/3) on Core (0xb2799ed) returned 0x9336d0c…, 0x4f0aa59…, 0xf079c35…; eth_getCode on all three returned 0x (EOA confirmed).

controls.label: RingLaunchpad contract minter
controls.capDescription: Contract holds MINTER_ROLE; minting constrained by launchpad logic.
controls.evidence: At block 25295203, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 2) on Core returned 0x8814a2a…; Blockscout shows ContractName: RingLaunchpad.

controls.label: Ring Protocol Core / GOVERN_ROLE (minter-admin)
controls.capDescription: GOVERN_ROLE holders can grant/revoke MINTER_ROLE at will. Current GOVERN_ROLE: Core itself (0xb2799…) + 2 EOAs (0xff790875…, 0x9336d0c…). No revocations recorded.
controls.evidence: At block 25295203, getRoleMemberCount(GOVERN_ROLE) on Core = 3; getRoleMember returned 0xb2799…, 0xff790875…, 0x9336d0c…; eth_getCode on 0xff790875… returned 0x (EOA). Core source confirmed as Fei-fork Permissions/AccessControl on Blockscout.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: USDR token (AssetToken / CoreRef) verified on Blockscout. Core contract (0xb2799ed) enumerated via getRoleMember: MINTER_ROLE has 4 holders (3 EOAs + RingLaunchpad contract); GOVERN_ROLE has 3 holders (Core itself + 2 EOAs). No RoleRevoked events recorded. Token has no proxy (EIP-1967 slots zero). Minting is uncapped for any MINTER_ROLE holder; GOVERN_ROLE can add new minters freely.
